caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular layout containing six main sections separated by straight lines. Across the upper half, there are two large vertical rectangles labeled "C-2" and "C-3," each with several vertical lines and numbered horizontal arrows (labeled 8, 9, 9, 10, 10, 11, and 11 for C-2; 11, 12, 12, 13, and 13 for C-3) marked along their top edge. Below each of these rectangles, in the same vertical alignment, are smaller rectangles labeled "D-2" beneath both "C-2" and "C-3," divided from the larger sections above by a horizontal line, with a dashed line marking the upper edge of both D-2 sections. At the bottom of the drawing are two side-by-side horizontal rectangles labeled "E-2" and "F-3," with the label "center back" written along the right edge of F-3. Along the right edge above F-3 is the vertically written text "CENTER BACK-CUT ON FOLD." The composition is rendered in pencil on off-white or beige paper, with dashed, straight, and slightly curved lines used for sectioning and marking dimensions. The labels and text are drawn in a fine, legible handwriting style.
